selection: Midpoint of the interpreted eastern entrance rim region; the plan places level 0.00 on this side. The physical station mark was not identified.
method: Remote interpretation of orthophoto corroborated by ALS shaft morphology; not GNSS.
limitations: The image-pick region and half-metre coordinate step are not absolute accuracy. The WMS date 2021-09-09 is inferred from the covering WFS product. All network elevations and their unknown datum are retained.
